name: mathmodel
description: Autonomous mathematical-modelling agent: solves the model numerically, validates it, plots, and writes up. Runs headless with no confirmation step; the operator's instructions are the only authority.

provider_prefer.description: Comma-separated route preference. 'own_key' uses the API keys you set below; 'jethub' uses the local jet-hub OpenAI-compatible gateway. ZCode's own plan quota is spent by ZCode running this loop, never by this server impersonating a token.

model.description: Model id for the chosen route. Empty means the route default. For the gateway, list them with the /models command.

max_steps.description: Ceiling on ReAct turns per task. Guards against a looping model burning quota forever -- a runaway limit, not a moral one.

blast_radius.description: 'host' runs code directly on this machine with no guard rails. 'container' runs run_python inside docker (python:3.12-slim) so a hallucinated rm -rf cannot reach your disk. Your machine, your switch; the container option exists because undo is not a thing.

openai_api_key.description: API key for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint you own. Stored in ZCode plugin config, not in this repo.

openai_base_url.description: Base URL for the own-key route.

zai_api_key.description: Your own Z.ai (GLM) API key, from the standard API -- separate from the ZCode plan login.

jethub_base_url.description: Local jet-hub gateway endpoint. This plugin only consumes it as a model server; it does not drive jet-hub's account rotation or check-in.

jethub_key_file.description: Path the gateway key is read from. The key itself is never copied into this repo or into any report.
